narrative:
## Handover Summary — Deposit Beta & Pricing

The deposit pricing grid is approved with a blended beta inside the 45% ALCO ceiling.

## Key Decisions
- Savings pass-through reduced from 58% to 52% on non-promotional balances
- Tiered private banking pricing above PLN 1M for ex-Citi Warsaw clients
- Legacy SME overnight sweep bonus withdrawn in the South

## Recommendation for Loan Pricing & Margin
Funding-cost relief from deposits should not be passed straight to loan pricing. Lending should hold spreads, especially on SME and leasing.

## Risk Factors
- Outflow to money-market funds and Treasury retail bonds
- Competitive response from digital challengers

signals.title: Polish Banks Deposit Pricing Survey
signals.excerpt: Average savings account rates at the top-10 Polish banks fell ~60bp over the quarter, faster than at challenger banks, as lenders defend NIM.

signals.title: Citi Handlowy Retail Integration Completed
signals.excerpt: Migration of the Citi Handlowy retail business completed on 15 June 2026: PLN 22.1B of deposits, PLN 6B of loans, PLN 8.9B AuM and ~1,600 employees now on VeloBank systems.
